crossRefs.note: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.
He also did so for the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall;

people.name: Holy_Place
people.line: The inner sanctuary of the Tabernacle and Temple

translations.web: As for the temple, the door posts were squared. As for the face of the sanctuary, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.
translations.bsb: The outer sanctuary had a rectangular doorframe, and the doorframe of the sanctuary was similar.
translations.kjv: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance
translations.asv: As for the temple, the door-posts were squared; and as for the face of the sanctuary, the appearance thereof was as the appearance of the temple.
